title: Keep a bare claim or release from counting as a local planning change in an incremental task-sync import
outcome: Keep a bare claim or release from counting as a local planning change in an incremental task-sync import
acceptance: After an incremental import, a claim on task X, then another host's commit that edits X, the next incremental import holds X (exit 3) instead of refusing as task_sync_divergent_planning
A claim or release alone never puts a task in the import's local-change set; real planning edits still do
